---
title: "Glass + brand.yml"
format: html
---

Sit shinyglass on a Quarto `_brand.yml` palette. The brand file in this
folder supplies the accent; pass it to `glass_theme(primary = )`.

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(shiny)
library(shinyglass)

# brand.yml >= 0.1: read_brand_yml()
primary <- "#007AFF"
if (requireNamespace("brand.yml", quietly = TRUE)) {
  brand <- brand.yml::read_brand_yml()
  if (!is.null(brand$color$primary)) primary <- brand$color$primary
}

ui <- glass_page(
  title = "Brand + glass",
  preset = "auto",
  persist = TRUE,
  scene = "mesh",
  theme = glass_theme(preset = "auto", primary = primary, persist = TRUE, scene = "mesh"),
  p("Accent comes from _brand.yml. Toggle Light / Dark / Auto and drag intensity.")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe_glass(input, session)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
